name: implementation-workflow
description: Japanese implementation planning, auditing, and execution workflow for Codex and Claude Code, with UX-first review loops, simplicity review, and verification discipline.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, audit, implement, and verify engineering work in Japanese
interface.longDescription: A shared implementation workflow for Codex and Claude Code. It audits existing implementations, creates executable Japanese implementation plans, reviews them from UX, simplicity, schema, security, delivery, and adversarial perspectives, then executes accepted plans with verification and learning persistence.
